name: io.github.MoleCare/molecare-mcp
description: Educational dermatology knowledge and lesion tooling. No credentials needed. Not a medical device.

environmentVariables.name: MOLECARE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a MoleCare-compatible HTTP API. Omit to run in mock mode with synthetic data.

environmentVariables.name: MOLECARE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the MoleCare API. Only needed when MOLECARE_API_URL points at a real backend.

environmentVariables.name: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI
environmentVariables.description: MLflow tracking server for experiment and model-run tools. Mocked when unset.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region for EC2 and CloudWatch operations tools. Credentials come from the standard AWS chain.
